text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Hussein says Jordanian-Saudi ties are "strong and historic", expected to depart on Thursday to perform minor pilgrimage and meet King Fahd.
- Snow expected on Thursday as cold spell intensifies, the heavy rains save the agricultural season.
- Prime Minister Kabariti agrees during a parliamentary session with Islamic deputies who attack papers that focus on immoral issues.
- Kabariti says weekly tabloids that publish stories about vice and immoral behaviour are committing breaches of the law that "we cannot keep silent about and need to deal with as soon as possible."
- King Hussein will discuss with Saudi King Fahd bilateral ties and latest developments in the region.
- Planning Ministry official says a regional study on transport links between Jordan, Egypt, Palestinian areas and Israel is at an advanced stage, with four projects that are Jordanian.
- Beggars arrested using mobile phones, 52 swoops against vagrancy.
- Local stock improve with advancing stock outstripping losers.
- Kabariti and Palestinian official Tarifi review trade and economic ties.
